mapper.insert: INSERT INTO urls (original_url, short_code, click_count, created_at, expires_at, user_id, team_id) VALUES (#{originalUrl}, #{shortCode}, #{clickCount}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{userId}, #{teamId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, original_url, short_code, click_count, created_at, expires_at, user_id, team_id FROM urls WHERE original_url = #{originalUrl} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, original_url, short_code, click_count, created_at, expires_at, user_id, team_id FROM urls ORDER BY created_at DESC
